mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.target_dm_id AS targetDmId, r.target_dmc AS targetDmc, r.ref_type AS refType, r.ref_position AS refPosition, d.dmc_code AS dmcCode, d.tech_name AS techName, d.info_name AS infoName FROM ietm_dm_reference r INNER JOIN ietm_data_module d ON r.target_dm_id = d.id WHERE r.source_dm_id = #{sourceDmId} AND d.status = '1' AND d.is_latest = '1' ORDER BY r.ref_type, r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.source_dm_id AS sourceDmId, r.ref_dmc AS refDmc, r.ref_type AS refType, r.ref_position AS refPosition, d.dmc_code AS dmcCode, d.tech_name AS techName, d.info_name AS infoName FROM ietm_dm_reference r INNER JOIN ietm_data_module d ON r.source_dm_id = d.id WHERE r.target_dm_id = #{targetDmId} AND d.status = '1' AND d.is_latest = '1' ORDER BY r.ref_type, r.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ietm_dm_reference WHERE source_dm_id = #{dmId} OR target_dm_id = #{dmId}

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO ietm_dm_reference (id, source_dm_id, target_dm_id, ref_type, ref_dmc, target_dmc, ref_position, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{item.id}, #{item.sourceDmId}, #{item.targetDmId}, #{item.refType}, #{item.refDmc}, #{item.targetDmc}, #{item.refPosition}, #{item.createBy}, SYSDATE)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ietm_dm_reference (id, source_dm_id, target_dm_id, ref_type, ref_dmc, target_dmc, ref_position, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{sourceDmId}, #{targetDmId}, #{refType}, #{refDmc}, #{targetDmc}, #{refPosition}, #{createBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
WITH ref_chain(dmId, dmcCode, techName, infoName, refType, refPosition, depth, path) AS ( -- 基础查询：根节点（起点） SELECT d.id AS dmId, d.dmc_code AS dmcCode, d.tech_name AS techName, d.info_name AS infoName, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS refType, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(500)) AS refPosition, 0 AS depth, CAST(d.id AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS path FROM ietm_data_module d WHERE d.id = #{rootDmId} AND d.status = '1' AND d.is_latest = '1'
UNION ALL
-- 递归查询：根据 refType 决定遍历方向 SELECT target_d.id AS dmId, target_d.dmc_code AS dmcCode, target_d.tech_name AS techName, target_d.info_name AS infoName, r.ref_type AS refType, r.ref_position AS refPosition, rc.depth + 1 AS depth, rc.path || ',' || CAST(target_d.id AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS path FROM ref_chain rc INNER JOIN ietm_dm_reference r ON ( (#{refType} = 'out' AND rc.dmId = r.source_dm_id) OR (#{refType} = 'in' AND rc.dmId = r.target_dm_id) ) INNER JOIN ietm_data_module target_d ON ( (#{refType} = 'out' AND r.target_dm_id = target_d.id) OR (#{refType} = 'in' AND r.source_dm_id = target_d.id) ) WHERE target_d.status = '1' AND target_d.is_latest = '1' AND rc.depth < 10 AND INSTR(',' || rc.path || ',', ',' || CAST(target_d.id AS VARCHAR(4000)) || ',') = 0 ) -- 筛选出包含目标DM的路径，并返回该路径上的所有节点 SELECT dmId AS "dmId", dmcCode AS "dmcCode", techName AS "techName", infoName AS "infoName", refType AS "refType", refPosition AS "refPosition", depth AS "depth", path AS "path" FROM ref_chain WHERE path LIKE '%' || #{targetDmId} || '%' OR dmId = #{targetDmId} ORDER BY depth
